title: FUSE: Fairness-aware Update Screening against Byzantine Exploitation in $q$-Fair Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Client-level fair federated learning, in the form of $q$-fair federated learning ($q$-FFL), agnostic federated learning, or tilted empirical risk minimization, has emerged as an attractive solution to equalize utility across heterogeneous clients. This paradigm grants high-loss clients greater relative influence, while a central server aggregates their loss-weighted updates into a single shared model. Yet, the Byzantine robustness of $q$-fair federated learning has been largely neglected, leaving the server unable to tell legitimate fairness-induced amplification from malicious update scaling. To address this critical gap, we formalize the problem of Byzantine-robust $q$-fair federated learning under an \emph{update-only interface}, in which the server observes nothing but the fairness-scaled client updates. translated_title: FUSE：面向 q-公平联邦学习中抗拜占庭利用的公平性感知更新筛选
translated_abstract: 客户端级公平联邦学习，以 q-公平联邦学习、不可知联邦学习或倾斜经验风险最小化等形式出现，已成为均衡异构客户端间效用的有吸引力的解决方案。该范式赋予高损失客户端更大的相对影响力，同时由中央服务器将其按损失加权的更新聚合为一个共享模型。然而，q-公平联邦学习的拜占庭鲁棒性在很大程度上被忽视了，导致服务器无法区分合法的由公平性引起的更新放大与恶意的更新缩放。为了填补这一关键空白，我们在“仅更新接口”下形式化了拜占庭鲁棒的 q-公平联邦学习问题，在该接口下，服务器只能观察到按公平性缩放后的客户端更新。我们在共享类条件标签偏斜情形下的分析表明，公平性缩放保持了非负类混合结构……
tldr: 该论文提出了FUSE方法，首次在服务器仅能观察公平性缩放更新的“仅更新接口”下形式化了拜占庭鲁棒的q-公平联邦学习问题，通过公平性感知的更新筛选机制，使服务器能够区分合法的公平性放大与恶意的拜占庭攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FUSE, which formalizes Byzantine-robust q-fair federated learning under an update-only interface and introduces a fairness-aware update screening mechanism that enables the server to distinguish legitimate fairness-induced amplification from malicious Byzantine exploitation.
